course.title: Materials Manufacturing Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A 300 mm wide strip 25 mm thick is fed through a rolling mill with two powered rolls each of (12) radius = 230 mm. The work thickness is to be reduced to 22 mm in one pass at a roll speed of 45 rev/min. The work material has a flow urve defined by $k { = } 2 7 0 \mathrm { M P a }$ and $n = 0 . 1 3$ , and the coefficient of friction is assumed to be 0.1i. Determine if the friction is sufficient to permit the rolling operation to be accomplished. If so, calculate the roll force, torque and horsepower.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
